name: ogxo
description: The ogxo plugin set in one install: code review, git and GitHub workflows, browser debugging, decision and planning skills, color-system design, safety hooks, specialist subagents, the status line, and model routing. Installing it installs each of those plugins; thryx (needs a ThryX account) and ogxo-format (rewrites every file Claude edits) are left out and install on their own.
